metadata.description: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at JCK Las Vegas 2027, June 4–7 at The Venetian Expo. Explore natural diamonds and book a trade sourcing meeting.

hero.title: JCK Las Vegas 2027 – Meet Uniglo Diamonds
hero.lead: JCK Las Vegas 2027 – Meet Uniglo Diamonds
hero.para1: JCK Las Vegas 2027 takes place from June 4 to 7 at The Venetian Expo in Las Vegas, Nevada. The business-to-business jewelry show brings qualified retailers, diamond buyers, designers, manufacturers, wholesalers and other industry professionals together for four days of sourcing, education and networking.
hero.para2: Uniglo Diamonds is preparing to return to JCK as a natural-diamond supplier. Buyers can meet the team to examine loose natural diamonds and discuss individually graded center stones, fancy shapes, matched pairs, calibrated selections and repeat manufacturing requirements.
hero.para3: The Uniglo Diamonds booth number and final 2027 show-floor hours have not yet been officially confirmed. Both will be added to this page when current information becomes available.

eventDetails.note: Although the main JCK show begins on Friday, June 4, selected areas open on June 3 and Luxury invitation-only days run June 2–3. Visitors should confirm their badge access before planning which areas to attend.

datesVenue.title: JCK Las Vegas 2027 Dates & Venue
datesVenue.para1: The main JCK show opens on Friday, June 4 and continues through Monday, June 7, 2027, at The Venetian Expo.
datesVenue.para2: Selected areas and programs are scheduled to open on Thursday, June 3. These include AGTA and GEMS, the Hong Kong Pavilion, the Lifestyle Pavilion and selected JCK Talks sessions. Visitors interested in these areas should confirm that their badge provides the necessary access.
datesVenue.para3: Luxury's invitation-only days are scheduled for Wednesday, June 2 and Thursday, June 3. Access is limited to approved Luxury attendees and should not be assumed to be included with every JCK registration.
datesVenue.para4: Final opening hours for the 2027 show floor have not yet been published clearly enough to use as confirmed information. Previous years' times should not be copied onto this page.

registration.title: JCK Las Vegas 2027 Registration & Admission
registration.para1: JCK is a trade-only event and is not open to the general public. Registration is intended for qualified professionals connected to the jewelry and watch industries, and every application is subject to approval.
registration.para2: A new registration is required for each edition of the show. Attending JCK in a previous year does not automatically provide admission to the 2027 event.
registration.para3: Applicants may need to provide documentation confirming both their company's connection to the jewelry industry and their employment or ownership relationship with that business. Requirements vary according to badge category.
admissionPoints: Previous JCK badges cannot be reused
Business cards are not accepted as qualification documents
Company and employment documents may be required
Submitted company details must match the registration
A current government-issued photo ID is required for badge collection
Photocopies and phone images of identification are not accepted
Each attendee can collect only the badge connected to their own ID
Children under 14 are generally not permitted
Babies in approved carriers may be admitted with show-management approval
Strollers are not permitted on the show floor
registration.para4: Visitors should complete registration and receive approval before booking nonrefundable travel.

whatIs.title: What Is JCK Las Vegas?
whatIs.para1: JCK is a major international buying and networking event for the jewelry and watch trade. For more than 30 years, the exhibition has connected retailers, manufacturers, designers, suppliers and professional service providers in Las Vegas.
whatIs.para2: The organiser reports that the event attracts approximately 17,500 attendees and more than 1,800 exhibitors annually. The show covers loose diamonds, colored gemstones, fine jewelry, bridal collections, watches, packaging, technology, security, manufacturing equipment and other commercial services.
whatIs.para3: JCK is structured around multiple show-floor neighborhoods and product categories. This helps buyers concentrate on relevant areas rather than attempting to examine the entire exhibition without a plan.
whatIs.para4: The event also includes JCK Talks, networking programs and other professional sessions covering subjects such as retail strategy, consumer behavior, technology, security, marketing and industry trends.
whatIs.para5: For jewelry businesses, the commercial value comes from combining product discovery, supplier evaluation, education and relationship-building within the same trip.

exhibitors.title: JCK Las Vegas 2027 Exhibitors
exhibitors.para1: The final 2027 exhibitor directory should be treated as the primary source for participating companies and booth locations. Buyers should check that the directory is displaying the 2027 edition before using it to plan appointments.
exhibitors.para2: JCK exhibitors generally represent a broad range of product and service categories.
exhibitors.para3: Buyers should build a shortlist based on commercial requirements rather than selecting exhibitors only because they present a large inventory.

supplierQuestions.title: Diamond Suppliers at JCK Las Vegas 2027
supplierQuestions.para1: JCK gives retailers and manufacturers an opportunity to compare diamond suppliers in person. However, buyers should evaluate more than the number of stones displayed.
supplierQuestions.para2: A suitable diamond supplier should be able to understand how the diamonds will be used, what specifications are commercially important and whether similar requirements can be supported after the exhibition.
supplierQuestions.questionLabel: Questions to ask potential suppliers include:
questions: Do you specialize in natural, lab-grown or both diamond categories?
Which shapes and carat ranges are normally available?
Can diamonds be sourced within defined measurement ranges?
Which grading reports and documentation are available?
Can you prepare matched pairs or calibrated selections?
Can you work from existing mounting dimensions?
What information is needed for repeat orders?
How are availability and delivery expectations communicated?
Can the supplier support the buyer's target market and price position?
What happens after the trade-show appointment?

whatCanSource.title: What Diamond Buyers Can Source at JCK
whatCanSource.para1: JCK brings together suppliers serving different areas of the diamond and jewelry market. The show can therefore support several sourcing objectives during the same visit.

items.title: Individually Graded Center Stones
items.body: Retailers and bespoke jewelers can compare documented natural diamonds for engagement rings, anniversary jewelry and individual customer commissions. Relevant requirements may include shape, carat range, measurements, color, clarity, grading laboratory and target price.

items.title: Fancy-Shaped Natural Diamonds
items.body: Oval, Pear, Emerald, Cushion, Radiant, Marquise, Princess, Asscher and Heart-shaped diamonds can support different bridal, gifting and design requirements. Buyers should assess outline and proportions alongside the grading information.

items.title: Matched Diamond Pairs
items.body: Diamond earrings and symmetrical designs require stones with compatible measurements, outline, color, clarity and visual character.

items.title: Calibrated Diamonds
items.body: Manufacturers may require diamonds within controlled dimensions and quality ranges for eternity rings, tennis jewelry, multi-stone designs and repeatable collections.

items.title: Diamonds for Existing Mountings
items.body: When a stone must fit an existing ring or component, accurate minimum and maximum measurements are essential. Buyers should bring the mounting dimensions or a detailed technical specification.

items.title: Repeat Manufacturing Requirements
items.body: Manufacturers and wholesalers can discuss quantities, acceptable tolerances, production schedules, delivery expectations and potential repeat availability.

meet.title: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at JCK Las Vegas 2027
meet.para1: Uniglo Diamonds plans to present a selected range of natural diamonds for retailers, wholesalers, manufacturers and designers. The final show selection will depend on availability closer to the exhibition.
meet.para2: The purpose of a meeting is not simply to examine a large number of stones. The Uniglo team first seeks to understand the intended jewelry application, customer profile, required specifications and commercial objective.
meet.para3: Buyers with defined requirements should provide them before the exhibition so relevant options can be considered where availability permits.
meet.meetingLabel: Buyers can prepare to discuss requirements across:
meet.imageAlt: Jewelry buyer reviewing natural diamonds with Uniglo Diamonds

usMarket.title: Natural Diamonds for US Jewelry Retailers & Manufacturers
usMarket.para1: The US jewelry market includes national retailers, independent jewelers, bridal specialists, custom designers, wholesalers and manufacturers. Each type of business may require a different balance of appearance, grading, price, quantities and repeatability.
usMarket.para2: Two diamonds with similar grading descriptions can have different visual characteristics. Proportions, outline, inclusion placement and face-up dimensions can influence how a diamond looks and how effectively it works in a particular design.
usMarket.considerLabel: Natural diamonds should be evaluated through the complete combination of characteristics relevant to the finished piece:

bridal.title: Natural Diamonds for Bridal Jewelry
bridal.para1: Bridal jewelry remains an important category for US retailers and manufacturers. Requirements may range from individually graded solitaire diamonds to coordinated center and side stones for repeatable engagement-ring designs.
bridal.para2: Retailers should identify gaps in their current assortment before the show. These might involve a missing shape, carat range, quality combination or commercial price position.

gifting.title: Natural Diamonds for Gifting and Everyday Jewelry
gifting.para1: Natural diamonds are also used in jewelry for birthdays, anniversaries, graduations, personal achievements, self-purchase and everyday wear.
gifting.para2: The most suitable specifications will depend on the design, retail audience and intended price position. One general quality standard is unlikely to suit every jewelry category.

matching.title: Matching and Calibration for Jewelry Manufacturing
matching.para1: Matching becomes important whenever several diamonds will appear in the same piece. Earrings, three-stone rings, eternity bands, tennis bracelets and other multi-stone designs require consistency across the characteristics visible in the finished jewelry.
matching.para2: Measurements, acceptable tolerances, quantities and intended settings should be provided at the beginning of the sourcing process.
matching.imageAlt: Matched pairs and calibrated natural diamonds for jewelry manufacturing

measurements.title: Measurements and Proportions
measurements.para1: Carat weight does not provide a complete picture of a polished diamond's size or appearance. Two diamonds with the same carat weight may have different dimensions and face-up presence.
measurements.para2: Measurements are particularly important for fancy shapes. The length-to-width ratio can influence whether an Oval appears slender or broad, whether an Emerald cut has the desired outline and whether a Pear shape suits the intended setting.
measurements.considerLabel: Before an appointment, buyers should identify:
considerItems: Visual preferences not represented fully by a grading report

certification.title: Certification and Documentation
certification.para1: Documentation requirements can vary according to the diamond's size, value, intended market and jewelry application.
certification.para2: Some buyers require individual grading reports for center stones. Smaller or calibrated diamonds may use different commercial documentation. Internal inventory, insurance, shipping and import procedures may also influence what information is required.
certification.para3: Documentation should be discussed before a selection is prepared.
considerItems: Whether individual grading reports are required
Information required for internal inventory systems
Documentation needed for importing or shipping
Whether documents must accompany each diamond
Requirements for matched pairs or calibrated layouts

inPerson.title: Why Examine Natural Diamonds in Person?
inPerson.para1: Digital inventory tools make it easier to begin sourcing remotely, but an in-person assessment can provide additional commercial insight.
inPerson.para2: A grading report communicates technical information, but it cannot show every aspect of a diamond's appearance in different lighting or demonstrate how several diamonds compare beside one another.
inPerson.assessLabel: At JCK, buyers may be able to evaluate:
inPerson.para3: This direct comparison can be particularly valuable before a larger purchase or repeat-supply arrangement.
inPerson.imageAlt: Natural-diamond sourcing meeting at JCK Las Vegas

prepare.title: How Buyers Should Prepare for JCK Las Vegas
prepare.para1: JCK is a large international show with numerous exhibitors, neighborhoods and professional programs. Buyers attending without a clear plan may find it difficult to prioritize the most relevant opportunities.
prepare.para2: Appointments should not be scheduled too closely together. Moving between levels and show-floor areas at The Venetian Expo can take longer than expected during busy periods.
prepItems: Confirm that the application has been approved
Check which areas open on June 3
Establish approximate quantities and price parameters
Review relevant JCK Talks and networking sessions
prepare.transportPara1: The Venetian Expo is located at 201 Sands Avenue, Las Vegas, Nevada 89169. It is connected to The Venetian and The Palazzo resort complex.
prepare.transportPara2: Visitors staying on the property can follow signs through the resort and convention areas. Those staying elsewhere should check the official JCK travel information closer to the event for recommended transportation, hotel and shuttle arrangements.
prepare.transportPara3: Buyers carrying valuable goods, samples or sensitive documentation should also review JCK's current safety and security guidance before attending.

partnerships.title: Building Supplier Relationships Beyond the Show
partnerships.para1: The value of JCK is not measured only by orders written during the exhibition. It also comes from the relationships and conversations that continue after the show closes.
partnerships.para2: After the exhibition, a buyer may wish to request a focused selection, review specific grading reports, refine requirements or confirm production schedules.
partnerships.para3: Long-term sourcing relationships are built through consistent quality, transparent communication, reliable service and a clear understanding of the buyer's business objectives.

items.question: When is JCK Las Vegas 2027?
items.answer: The main exhibition will take place from Friday, June 4 through Monday, June 7, 2027.

items.question: Where will JCK Las Vegas 2027 be held?
items.answer: The show will be held at The Venetian Expo, 201 Sands Avenue, Las Vegas, Nevada 89169.

items.question: What are the 2027 show-floor hours?
items.answer: The final JCK show-floor hours have not yet been confirmed clearly enough for publication. This page will be updated when the organiser publishes the complete 2027 schedule.

items.question: Do any JCK areas open before June 4?
items.answer: Yes. AGTA and GEMS, the Hong Kong Pavilion, the Lifestyle Pavilion and selected JCK Talks sessions are scheduled to open on Thursday, June 3, 2027. Visitors should confirm their badge access and the final timetable.

items.question: What are the Luxury invitation-only dates?
items.answer: Luxury's invitation-only days are scheduled for June 2 and 3, 2027. Attendance requires the appropriate approval and registration.

items.question: Is JCK Las Vegas open to the public?
items.answer: No. JCK is a business-to-business jewelry and watch trade show. Registration is reviewed, and applicants may need to provide documents proving their connection to the industry.

items.question: Is a new registration required for 2027?
items.answer: Yes. Every edition requires a new registration. A badge from a previous JCK event does not provide admission to the 2027 show.

items.question: Can a business card be used as a qualification document?
items.answer: No. JCK states that business cards are not accepted as qualification documents.

items.question: What identification is needed to collect a badge?
items.answer: A current government-issued photo ID is required. Photocopies and photographs stored on a phone are not accepted.

items.question: Are children allowed at JCK?
items.answer: Children under 14 are generally not permitted. Babies in carriers may be admitted with show-management approval, but strollers are not allowed on the show floor.

items.question: Where can buyers find the 2027 exhibitor list?
items.answer: Buyers should use JCK's official exhibitor directory. They should confirm that the directory is displaying the 2027 edition before relying on booth information.

items.question: What is Uniglo Diamonds' JCK booth number?
items.answer: The 2027 booth number has not yet been officially confirmed. It will be added to this page when the current show directory and floor plan are available.

items.question: What can buyers discuss with Uniglo Diamonds?
items.answer: Buyers can discuss natural diamonds for center stones, bridal jewelry, matched pairs, calibrated layouts, existing mountings, multi-stone jewelry and repeat manufacturing requirements.

items.question: Should buyers book an appointment?
items.answer: Advance booking is recommended for buyers with specific requirements. Providing the preferred shapes, carat ranges, measurements, colors, clarities, quantities and documentation requirements will help create a more focused meeting.

finalCta.title: Book a Meeting with Uniglo at JCK Las Vegas
finalCta.para: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at JCK to discuss natural diamonds selected around your retail, manufacturing, wholesale or design requirements. When requesting an appointment, provide your preferred shapes, carat ranges, measurements, color and clarity combinations, grading-report requirements, quantities, intended jewelry applications and approximate commercial parameters.
